Shared signed event intake v1.0.0

Reusable webhook that receives a signed GuardianHub event and verifies the HMAC signature, timestamp tolerance and nonce presence. Call this as a sub-workflow, or copy the Verify node into agent workflows.

parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto');const s=$env.N8N_GUARDIANHUB_SIGNING_SECRET;if(!s)throw new Error('N8N_GUARDIANHUB_SIGNING_SECRET not configured');const body=$json.body||'';const sig=String($json.headers['x-gh-signature']||'').toLowerCase();const computed=crypto.createHmac('sha256',s).update(JSON.stringify(body)).digest('hex');if(sig!==computed)throw new Error('Invalid signature');const ts=parseInt($json.headers['x-gh-timestamp']||'0',10);if(!ts||Math.abs(Date.now()-ts)>300000)throw new Error('Expired timestamp');return[{json:{body,headers:$json.headers,timestamp:String(ts),nonce:$json.headers['x-gh-nonce']||'',correlation_id:$json.headers['x-gh-correlation-id']||''}}];
